description:
Open source audio player


Changes since 4.6:
- Use XDG cache dir to store temporary files (https://github.com/audacious-media-player/audacious/issues/1817)
- Accept embedded lyrics in more cases (https://github.com/audacious-media-player/audacious/issues/1818)
- Bump .so and plugin ABI versions retrospectively (https://github.com/audacious-media-player/audacious/issues/1819)
- Include Georgian translation (https://github.com/audacious-media-player/audacious/issues/1820)
- Fix build on systems using musl instead of glibc (https://github.com/audacious-media-player/audacious/pull/1823)
Thanks to all the contributors and bug reporters.
